ownerDecisionsOnRecord.decision: The site is run by an individual owner doing business as DoUKnowBall; Massachusetts law; soft under 13 policy; one inbox, douknowball1@gmail.com, with a 30 day answer promise; any new ad network or SDK is added to privacy section 4 in the same publish.
No other company's game is named anywhere in the repo, comments included (he overruled leaving comments alone).
Five games retired by him ('too easy and boring', 'get rid of this game') stay reachable for old links but out of menus and sitemap, noindexed.

Trademark style addresses already retired: /deal-or-no-deal now points to /squad-deal and /jeopardy to /quiz-board. Storage keys and the database table keep the old spelling so saves and streaks carry over. No decision is recorded for /connections, the connect 4 pages or /footle.
About says one person makes the site, 'deliberately no name on the page; that is Anthony's call, and he can add it in one line if he wants it there'.
'add words like key words and description and all that so that on search it pops up higher up'.

Free forever, ads and sponsors only. Preserve existing routes and never break the homepage URL. Archive and answer pages are wanted; the spec's ban on pages built only for rankings 'must not be used to refuse them'. Owner approval is required before deleting major games or changing the brand.

The recovery addendum: do not re-apply until production is materially better; no padding, no word count inflation, no mass generated articles, no templated pages; build a real reference layer; factual pages carry source, last verified date and period; 'Do not fabricate a company or team'; the owner submits the review, nobody else.
The Record Books were NOT split into twelve champion pages ('a list of past champions sits on a thousand other sites'). Reversed on 2026-09-19 by Round 649 for search traffic.
'the note from the maker shouldnt say my name also it shouldnt pop up there'. His name was removed from every file under src and the note moved to /about.
AdSense readiness put first; review submission authorized after live checks.

Do not build a sixth explainer until Search Console shows the first five crawled; if they come back 'crawled, currently not indexed' the reference layer is not the lever. On 2026-09-15 all five were 'discovered, currently not indexed' with no recorded crawl; no later reading is in the repo.
'lots of key words and headings and sub headings and sub sub headings' on every game page, 'because we need more traction to our website'.

'what i need from you and chatgpt is to ensure we get accepted for google adsense and also to get all our pages indexed'. AdSense approval first, then correct data and complete gameplay in existing games, new games on hold. His AdSense prompt of that day: no filler, no fake FAQs, 'Do not stuff keywords into game pages', 'Do not add these sections mechanically', 'Do not mass-delete useful game pages', 'Do not keep weak pages indexed merely because they create more URLs'.
Improve the site and games first; AdSense and indexing later; pause new Google audit and review work. The 2026-10-08 brief ends that pause.
Still owed by him: whether docs/research/R1_soccer_sites.md and R3_creator_formats.md, which name competitors in the public repo, are deleted or gitignored.
